report_metadata.title: BusSense Large Public Dataset Audit Report

datasets.name: IIIT-H IDD: India Driving Dataset (and IDD-117K)
datasets.institution: Center for Visual Information Technology (CVIT), IIIT Hyderabad
datasets.paper_reference: Varma et al., 'IDD: A Dataset for Exploring Problems of Autonomous Navigation in Unconstrained Environments', WACV 2019

official_full_scale.images_frames: 10,004 densely labeled fine-annotation frames, 117k object detection frames (IDD-117K)
official_full_scale.classes: 34 finely annotated classes (Level 4), 7 Level 1 classes (drivable, vehicle, rider, person, obstacle, sidewalk, vegetation)
official_full_scale.cities_covered: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Indian National Highways, Rural roads
official_full_scale.access_method: Requires gated registration and academic research login on insaan.iiit.ac.in

disk_inventory.subset_nature: Sanity evaluation subset of 120 authentic Indian road scene images

released_baselines_and_checkpoints: Dilated ResNet-50 Semantic Segmenter (mIoU ~66.4% on Level 3)

bussense_usability.evaluation_role: Domain sanity testing for unstructured Indian road environments, lane discipline variance, and physical divider boundary inspection

datasets.name: IIIT-H MTSVD: Missing Traffic Signs Video Dataset
datasets.institution: Center for Visual Information Technology (CVIT), IIIT Hyderabad
datasets.paper_reference: CVIT IIIT-H Missing Traffic Signs in Unconstrained Road Videos (2023)

official_full_scale.images_frames: 1,590 to 2,000 driving video clips, 10,000+ unique traffic sign track IDs, 1.2M+ frames
official_full_scale.classes: 70+ standard IRC (Indian Roads Congress) traffic sign classes
official_full_scale.contextual_cues: Environmental cues predicting missing signs (road bends, intersections, pedestrian zones)
official_full_scale.access_method: Gated academic access on INSAAN repository

disk_inventory.subset_nature: Curated sample export of 57 images with 169 COCO sign annotations

released_baselines_and_checkpoints: Faster R-CNN ResNet-50 traffic sign baseline

bussense_usability.evaluation_role: Benchmarking traffic sign condition, occlusion, and missing sign candidates
bussense_usability.licensing_constraints: Local subset is too small for training from scratch (must not train tiny neural networks); use verified pretrained detectors

datasets.name: IIIT-H C4MTS: Challenge on Categorizing Missing Traffic Signs from Contextual Cues
datasets.paper_reference: NCVPRIPG 2023 Challenge Workshop on Contextual Sign Detection

official_full_scale.tasks: 4 core missing-sign contextual categories: Left-hand-curve, Right-hand-curve, Gap-in-median, Side-road-left
official_full_scale.evaluation_metric: Categorization accuracy and F1 score of predicting missing sign locations
official_full_scale.sequence_structure: Sequential video driving tracks with in-painted/absent signs

disk_inventory.subset_nature: Referenced architectural specification; challenge portal closed

bussense_usability.evaluation_role: Direct validation of BusSense expected-vs-observed spatial reasoning on median gaps and road curves

official_full_scale.images_frames: 4,706 images under varying illumination, weather, and wear conditions
official_full_scale.classes: 11 road marking categories (including pedestrian crossings, arrows, speed breakers)

disk_inventory.subset_nature: Sample split of 93 images (43 train, 25 val, 25 test)

bussense_usability.evaluation_role: Zebra crossing paint degradation and wear metrology evaluation

official_full_scale.images_frames: 2,400 waterlogged road scenes with binary water surface masks

disk_inventory.subset_nature: Sample split of 65 image-mask pairs (40 train, 15 val, 10 test)

bussense_usability.evaluation_role: Waterlogging extent and union denominator metrology validation

datasets.name: RSRD / Pothole Long Stereo Real-World Reel
datasets.institution: BusSense Authentic Driving Capture / RSRD Benchmark

official_full_scale.images_frames: 74 synchronized, calibrated Left+Right full HD (1920x1080) moving stereo frames
official_full_scale.classes: Potholes, cracks, asphalt surface, moving vehicle traffic

disk_inventory.subset_nature: Complete continuous 74-frame calibrated stereo driving reel

bussense_usability.evaluation_role: Primary real perception moving video rendering and 3D defect depth metrology

IIIT-H C4MTS (Challenge on Categorizing Missing Traffic Signs from Contextual Cues)
executive_summary.audit_conclusion: The IIIT-H datasets (IDD, MTSVD, C4MTS) represent massive multi-gigabyte collections (10k+ to 1.2M+ frames) hosted on gated academic infrastructure (insaan.iiit.ac.in). The local repository contains curated sample splits (120 IDD frames, 57 MTSVD images, 93 CeyMo images, 65 FRED images). These subsets are rigorously audited as EVALUATION_SANITY_DATASETS and must NEVER be used to train tiny fragile CNNs locally. BusSense strictly relies on verified pretrained models (YOLOv8n COCO, YOLOv11 Pothole/Crack, OpenCV SGBM, IGEV-Stereo) combined with deterministic 3D metrology and spatial reasoning.
